itinerary.title: Day 1 — Nairobi → Samburu
itinerary.notes: Begin your East African odyssey with a scenic journey from Nairobi to the semi-arid beauty of Samburu. Prepare to encounter unique wildlife species, known as the 'Samburu Special Five,' set against the striking backdrop of the Ewaso Ng'iro River.
itinerary.highlightSummary: Arrival in Kenya and scenic transfer to the rugged landscapes of the Samburu heartland.

morning.title: Jomo Kenyatta Airport Pickup
morning.subtitle: Warm meet and greet by your private safari guide.

morning.title: Transfer to Samburu
morning.subtitle: Enjoy a scenic drive through the Kenyan highlands towards the northern frontier.

afternoon.title: Gourmet Lodge Lunch
afternoon.subtitle: Refreshing arrival meal overlooking the panoramic bush vistas.

afternoon.title: Introductory Afternoon Game Drive
afternoon.subtitle: Explore the arid plains in search of reticulated giraffes and Grevy's zebras.

evening.title: Sunset Sundowners
evening.subtitle: Toast to the horizon as the African sun dips below the rugged hills.

evening.title: Campfire Dinner & Luxury Stay
evening.subtitle: Indulge in a multi-course dinner before retiring to Samburu Sopa Lodge.

itinerary.title: Great Rift Valley to Lake Nakuru Rhino Sanctuary
itinerary.notes: Descent into Great Rift Valley, game drive in Lake Nakuru tracking endangered black and white rhinos & Rothschild giraffes.
itinerary.highlightSummary: Close tracking of endangered black and white rhinos and flamingo flocks.

itinerary.title: Journey to the Maasai Mara Game Reserve
itinerary.notes: Drive through Narok into the Maasai Mara. Afternoon game drive in the Mara triangle and cultural visit to Maasai village.
itinerary.highlightSummary: Arrival in legendary Maasai Mara; evening cultural visit with Maasai elders.

itinerary.title: Maasai Mara Great Migration & River Crossings
itinerary.notes: Dawn hot air balloon flight with champagne bush breakfast, followed by full day tracking migration herds along the Mara River.
itinerary.highlightSummary: Sunrise hot air balloon flight over the savanna & Great Migration crossings.

itinerary.title: Full Day Predator Tracking & Mara Savannas
itinerary.notes: Morning and evening game drives seeking Big Five (lion prides, leopards, cheetah coalitions). Evening private bush dinner.
itinerary.highlightSummary: Big cat tracking and private lantern-lit wilderness bush dinner under the stars.
